name: wisp
description: Wisp — peer-to-peer chat over WebRTC. No accounts, no signaling server, no message store.

scripts.build:android: node tools/build-web.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.test:e2e: node --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=1 test/e2e/handshake.test.mjs test/e2e/group.test.mjs test/e2e/pairing.test.mjs test/e2e/mobile.test.mjs test/e2e/chatlist.test.mjs test/e2e/media.test.mjs test/e2e/swarm.test.mjs test/e2e/call.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:android
